notes.title: The Kostka is cross-platform
notes.notes:
If you like The Kostka you may also like it on other platforms.
We are not just on steam, but also on:
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/cs-cz/p/the-kostka/9p2k8q17ppzl
Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-cz/concept/10003141/
Nintendo Switch: mark in your calendars, store page not ready
If you own one, wishlist there too and its up to you, which platform you preffer.
